decision.explanation: The documents describe two distinct properties: the Simeon P. Smith House in Portsmouth, New Hampshire, built in 1810-11 (d00), and the Simeon Smith House in West Haven, Vermont, built in 1798-1800 (d02, d03); the conflicting 1910-11 date in d01 is identified as a textual error inconsistent with the Federal style and the 1913 fire mentioned.
